meaning:
ἀνα-κεφαλαιόω, ῶ
(see: κεφαλαιόω) [in Th., Al.: Psa.72:20 * ;]
to sum up, gather up, present as a whole: mid., Rom.13:9, Eph.1:10 (on WH. see Lft., Notes, 321 L; AR, in l; Cremer, 354, 748).†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: he might gather together in one

elsewhere.note: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments…
to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.
